review_notes: Human reviewer approved the export functional requirement, two linked acceptance criteria, complete status, exact-value preservation, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The earlier model result was comparison evidence only; its classification of the two qualifying conditions as functional requirements is not adopted.

source.input_text: Users need to export reports as PDF and CSV. PDF must include company logo. CSV must preserve formulas.

required_relationships: The PDF company-logo criterion and CSV formula-preservation criterion are linked to the report-export functional requirement.
required_evidence: Users need to export reports as PDF and CSV.

allowed_variations: The PDF and CSV export behavior may be represented as one combined functional requirement or two functional requirements if both formats and criterion links are preserved.
Summary wording and functional-requirement wording may be semantically equivalent while retaining PDF and CSV.
Item identifiers may differ if schema-valid and all relationships resolve correctly.
Category capitalization or semantically equivalent category labels may vary.
Confidence may vary as a schema-valid numeric value.
prohibited_claims: Any export format other than PDF and CSV, including XLSX.
Any acceptance criterion other than inclusion of company logo in PDF and preservation of formulas in CSV.
Any statement that CSV displays, calculates, evaluates, or executes formulas.
Any logo placement, size, format, branding rule, or source not stated in the input.
Any priority, stakeholder, deadline, platform, storage location, delivery method, or implementation detail not stated in the source.
Classifying both qualifying conditions only as functional requirements rather than acceptance criteria.

expected_special_handling.missing_information: Optional grounded questions may request unspecified export details, but they are not required for this test and must not change complete status.
